title: The Ball in the Well
lines: Bill has a red ball and a tall hill.
He rolls the ball off the top.
"Dad! The ball fell in!" yells Bill.
Dad gets a net and dips it in.
Dad tugs and tugs and gets the ball!
The ball is a mess. Bill gets a tub.
Bill fills it up and dips the ball in!

questions.listenFor: In a well. It is stated in the story — if they guess, have them find the line with the word well in it.

questions.ask: Who gets the ball out of the well?
questions.listenFor: Dad does. Bill yells for Dad, and Dad dips the net and tugs. Lines four to six.

questions.ask: The story says the ball is a mess. What does a mess look like?
questions.listenFor: Muddy, wet, not clean. Line seven says it. The ball had been down a well, so ask what got on it.
